notes.notes:

notes.title: Big Update Introduction tasks added, and UI Updates
notes.notes:
I have added more guidance in the beginning of the game to introduce mechanics.

I have also changed up the UI on the farming mechanics to limit the text prompts less.

I am currently working on a save progress feature but this is very tough at the moment.

Still working on a bug with the soil color and dehydration mechanics.

notes.title: Release Date Finally!
notes.notes:
The game has a release date, January 14th, 2024!

After multiple tests and reports from players, the game has had a few updates and now has an official release date!

Reports have been made that the entity pictured in the trailers does not match the over-all "art-style" of the game. This was also true with a few other NPC-type entities in the game so I have started to replace these with models that match more with the environment art-style. 

Included in the post is a screenshot of the replacement deer model.

I added a super awesome and cool, fully-voiced, intro.
All dialogue is fully voiced and more is being added as I am typing!

Added navigation beacon and blocking volumes to limit movement and introduce important locations!
